text:
jamie: Heads-up — we plan to run the users.profile schema migration + backfill next Tue. Need to lock down dual-write window and smoke-checks. Proposal: Tue 03:00 UTC, 20m dual-write, backfill ~2h. Who can own deploy + rollback?

alex: I can own the migration deploy. 03:00 UTC works for me. Backfill estimate 1.5–3h depending on replicas. Suggest dual-write 30m to be safe. We'll throttle writes.

sasha: I'm on-call that week — happy to do smoke checks and dashboards. What are the exact smoke steps you want me to run?

alex: Smoke checklist (short):
1) Hit /health and /metrics on the app tier
2) Read a few sample profiles from primary and replica (compare)
3) Insert/update a profile and verify read path returns latest
4) Watch tail latency and replication lag (<5s target)
5) Errors <0.1% and no new 5xx patterns

morgan: I'll own the backfill job. Plan: k8s job with parallelism=4, chunked by user_id range. Will monitor CPU/mem and DB IO. Add a kill-switch annotation so we can stop quickly.

jamie: Can we sketch a rollback checklist too? If the backfill or schema causes problems, what's the immediate step?

alex: Rollback plan (brief):
- Turn off dual-write (switch feature flag)
- Point reads to primary only (config change)
- Revert schema deploy via deploy-bot if needed
- Kill backfill job and restore pre-change config
Commands I'll put in the runbook, e.g.:
```
-- flip read source to primary
UPDATE service_config SET value='primary' WHERE key='profile_read_source';
-- cancel backfill job
kubectl delete job users-profile-backfill-<run-id>
```

jamie: @deploy-bot can you tentatively reserve 03:00 UTC and post the deploy notice? Also ping @sasha 10m before start.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: migration/users.profile at 1768012345 (03:00 UTC). Owner: alex. Notifying #eng-platform and @sasha. :white_check_mark:

morgan: Quick migration note — do the schema change in a short transaction (add column nullable), run backfill, then in a follow-up migration set NOT NULL and add constraints. Avoid long locks.

alex: Example migration snippet I'll include in PR: 
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN profile JSONB;
COMMIT;
-- backfill job reads in batches and writes into profile column
```

sasha: I'll run the smoke checklist and post results in this thread. Please @ me 10m beforehand.

jamie: Action items: alex = deploy owner + rollback commands in runbook, morgan = backfill owner + kill-switch, sasha = smoke checks, oncall = monitor. I'll update calendar invite and attach the runbook. Any objections? :eyes: 

morgan: none from me. :+1:

alex: all good. :shipit:

oncall: Pager duty covered. I'll be reachable during the window.
